subject: Mathematics
title: Class 10 Mathematics Olympiad — Paper 4
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: Which number should replace the question mark: 3, 9, 27, 81, ?
If '+' means '÷', '÷' means '-', '-' means 'x', and 'x' means '+', evaluate: 12 x 4 - 2 ÷ 3
In a row of children, Raj is 7th from the left and 12th from the right. How many children are in the row?
Find the missing number: 7, 14, 28, 56, __
A is taller than B but shorter than C. D is taller than C. Who is the tallest?
Arrange in a logical order: Seed, Flower, Fruit, Plant, Seedling
Pointing to a photograph, a man says, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl related to the man?
A is the father of B. C is the sister of A. How is C related to B?
Statement: All pens are pencils. All pencils are erasers. Conclusion: All pens are erasers.
Find the odd one out: Triangle, Square, Circle, Sphere
If 5 workers can build a wall in 12 days, how many days will 10 workers take?
A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
Find the next term in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, __
If in a certain code, MATH is written as NBUI, how is CODE written?
If North becomes East, East becomes South, and so on, what will South become?
Find the distance between points (3, 4) and (0, 0).
What is the 10th term of the AP: 2, 5, 8, 11, ...?
Find the coordinates of the point which divides the line segment joining (2,3) and (7,8) in the ratio 2:3.
Find the area of a circle whose radius is 7 cm (use pi = 22/7).
A die is thrown once. What is the probability of getting a number greater than 4?
A quadratic equation ax^2+bx+c=0 has equal roots when discriminant equals:
Two coins are tossed together. What is the probability of getting at least one head?
If alpha and beta are zeroes of x^2 - 3x + 2, find the value of alpha times beta.
What is the HCF of 96 and 404?
What is the degree of the polynomial 5x^4 - 3x^2 + 7?
Form a quadratic polynomial whose zeroes are 4 and -1.
If two triangles are similar with sides in ratio 2:3, what is the ratio of their areas?
Find the value of tan 45 degrees.
If one zero of the polynomial x^2 - (k+6)x + 2(2k-1) is negative of the other, find k.
In a grouped frequency distribution, what is used to estimate the mean when exact values are unknown?
options: The lower limit of each class
The class mark (mid-value) of each class interval
The upper limit of each class

questions.question: If p(x) = x^3 - 3x^2 + 2, find the remainder when p(x) is divided by (x-1) using the Remainder Theorem.
Find the mean of the following data: 4, 8, 10, 12, 16.
What is the probability of a sure (certain) event?
Find the coordinates of the centroid of a triangle with vertices (1,2), (3,4), (5,0).
Is the number 0.101001000100001... rational or irrational?
options: Rational, since it follows a pattern
Irrational, as it is non-terminating and non-recurring
Rational, as all decimals are rational

questions.question: A tank can be filled by pipe A in 6 hours and by pipe B in 12 hours. How long will both pipes together take to fill the tank?
A train 150 m long crosses a pole in 15 seconds. Find the speed of the train in m/s.
A shopkeeper's profit percentage is 20% on cost price of Rs. 250. Find the selling price.
A car travels 240 km in 4 hours. What is its average speed?
If 5 pens cost Rs. 60, what is the cost of 12 pens?
A room is 5m long and 4m wide. What is the cost of carpeting it at Rs. 50 per sq metre?
A sum of Rs. 5000 is invested at 8% simple interest per annum. Find the interest after 2 years.
A recipe requires 2 cups of flour for 8 servings. How many cups are needed for 20 servings?
Ravi buys a shirt marked at Rs. 800 with a 15% discount. What is the discounted price?
A sum doubles itself in 8 years at simple interest. Find the rate of interest per annum.
A quadratic equation representing the age problem: 'The product of Ramu's age 5 years ago and his age 9 years later is 15' leads to which correctly formed equation if x is his present age?
A cone and a hemisphere have equal base radius and equal volumes. Find the ratio of the height of the cone to the radius.
In a circle, two tangents are drawn from an external point P to touch the circle at A and B. If the angle APB = 60 degrees, what is the measure of angle AOB (O is the centre)?
The sum of the first n terms of an AP is given by Sn = 2n^2 + 3n. A student needs to find the 15th term without listing all terms. What method and result apply?
options: The 15th term equals a+14d without needing Sn; cannot be found
Use Tn = Sn/n; the 15th term is 33
Use Tn = Sn - S(n-1); the 15th term is 61

questions.question: Two poles of height 6 m and 11 m stand on a plane ground. If the distance between their feet is 12 m, find the distance between their tops using coordinate/Pythagoras reasoning.
options: 13 m (using the difference in height 5 m and base 12 m to form a right triangle: sqrt(5^2+12^2)=13)
